source.snippet: Initial thoughts: this is a bit ridiculous, I can just build that myself. And in fact, I have done already. Thoughts after about 3 minutes of browsing: OK, this actually makes sense and I see why people would pay for this. The value proposition is definitely there [for feature flag server getunleash.io]

problem_statement: Engineering teams self-host feature flag infrastructure but eventually recognise the operational overhead is not worth it compared to a managed service, yet switching costs and pricing uncertainty delay purchasing decisions.
target_segment: Backend/full-stack engineers and engineering managers at growth-stage startups who currently DIY their feature flag setup.
notes: Commenter explicitly says 'I see why people would pay for this — the value proposition is definitely there.' Classic build-vs-buy inflection signal. Competitor (Unleash) exists and is validated; opportunity may be a simpler/cheaper alternative or a migration-assist tool for teams switching from DIY. Buyer: engineering manager or CTO at 10–200 person company.
